newsitem.title: USA: Jaymark files amended IPO registration.
newsitem.headline: Jaymark files amended IPO registration.

text.p: Jaycor Inc on Tuesday said its newly formed parent company, Jaymark Inc, filed an amended registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the initial public offering of 1.3 million shares of Jaymark class A common stock.
Brean Murray & Co Inc will act as managing underwriter for the offering.
The number of shares excludes an over-allotment option provided for the underwriters.
The company amended the filing to include updated financial results for the year ended January 31. Details were not immediately available.
